attchmntText: Uravi Defence and Technology Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half-year period ended on September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Uravi Defence and Technology Limited announced the outcome of its Board meeting held on November 14, 2026. The Board approved the Unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The results include a Limited Review Report issued by M/s Viren Gandhi & Co., Statutory Auditors. The company reported a Net Profit of 112.24 Lakhs for the half year ended September 30, 2026, compared to 76.68 Lakhs for the same period in 2025. Earnings per share were 0.98 Rupees for the half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board Meeting commenced at 4:00 P.M. and concluded at 5:15 P.M. The financial results are available on the company website.
